clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 1 (a) and (b): nested write and fail probe. Child TSTORE and SSTORE writes inside a failing frame are undone and the parent's writes are kept, on all five networks.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Own eth_call with a code override on 2026-11-27: the parent writes TSTORE(1,0xAA) and SSTORE(2,0xAB), calls itself, the child writes 0xBB and 0xCC and reverts, the parent reads back. Every endpoint returned 0xAA, 0xAB and call success 0: rpc.mainnet.arc.io (arc/v1), arc-rpc.publicnode.com (reth v2.2.0-508cbdf), rpc.elysium.kinetiq.xyz (nitro vlocal go1.25.12), rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm ('hyperliquid evm Mainnet'), mainnet.megaeth.com/rpc (mega-reth v2.3.1-4499c42), bsc-dataseed1.bnbchain.org (Geth v1.8.2) and bsc-rpc.publicnode.com (reth-bsc v0.1.4-hotfix-23b510f). Lock (src/libraries/Lock.sol:10-26) and the delta accounting in PoolManager._accountDelta (src/PoolManager.sol:367-377) rely on exactly this, and unlock ends with the NonzeroDeltaCount check at src/PoolManager.sol:112.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Transient storage cleared between transactions, through eth_simulateV1.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Own eth_simulateV1 run: one call writes TSTORE(5,7) and SSTORE(5,9), a second call and a call in a second simulated block read both. The reads returned 0 and 9 on bsc-dataseed1.bnbchain.org, bsc-rpc.publicnode.com, rpc.elysium.kinetiq.xyz, arc-rpc.publicnode.com and rpc.hyperlend.finance/archive. rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm (-32601 Method not found), mainnet.megaeth.com/rpc (-32601 not supported) and rpc.mainnet.arc.io (-32601 method not supported) refuse eth_simulateV1, as the item says, so the cross-transaction reset stays untested on those three builds; the item states this gap and lists it as a low lead. The gap is low cost because Lock.unlock and lock pair inside one call (src/PoolManager.sol:104-114) and a leftover unlocked flag would make the next unlock revert with AlreadyUnlocked rather than skip the count check.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 1 (d) and Task 2: TokenRollbackProbe at the deployed PoolManager, including Arc native USDC per pinned build.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Own eth_call on Arc with the real PoolManager balance (code override at 0x8366a39CC670B4001A1121B8F6A443A643e40951): a child frame sends 1 wei of native value to a fresh address and reverts; the parent then reads BALANCE(recipient) and SELFBALANCE. arc_getVersion was read on each host: 37812c61 (rpc.mainnet.arc.io), 8e8edb7a (arc.drpc.org), 602eed3b (arc-rpc.publicnode.com) and db2d22c1 (rpc.blockdaemon.mainnet.arc.io). On all four the reverted case left the recipient at 0 and the PoolManager at 2452156240070775145164816, and the control without revert moved exactly 1 wei. Currency.balanceOfSelf (src/types/Currency.sol:90-96) read by _settle (src/PoolManager.sol:349-365) therefore cannot see a native movement that a reverted frame undid. The Cargo.toml at circlefin/arc-node 602eed3b returns HTTP 200 as cited. I did not recheck the face token transfer at 0x3600... or the log drop.
